title: Hanasato Minori — All Tuckered Out〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home.
I placed the towel for wiping his paws right over there.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Alright, Samo, lemme see your paws so I can clean them.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line:
No, wait! I'm not finished!
Lift up your hind legs for me again.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, Samo, you can come in now.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
He must've played quite a lot.
How was Shibao? Is he doing well?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, he was full of energy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But he did seem to put on a little weight.
His vet apparently even said that he needs to exercise more.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
So, did he get a good workout today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, we exercised a ton!
You had fun doing disc dog today, right, Samo?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Huh? Disc dog? Does that mean you threw a flying disc around and had him catch it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if Max knows that you're hurt...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think he's staying put because he doesn't want you to keep throwing that disc...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
He doesn't want to fetch the disc because he doesn't want to force his partner to keep throwing it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, would it be possible for Max and I to enter into that competition...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: What?! You're going to take his place, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanted to take his place in the competition, but I had so much trouble getting the disc to fly straight...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is where Kohane's friend, Shinonome, comes in... Even though he doesn't really like dogs, he said he'd participate.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, he doesn't like dogs? Is he going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was a little worried too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But he's become friends with Max after practicing lots and lots together. Now, he has no trouble taking the disc back!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna go cheer Shinonome and Max on, then head over to work and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's weird... I slept really well last night...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: You must be tired after all that activity. Why don't you get some rest before heading out again?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Minori? Wouldn't you rather sleep in your room...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Alright, let's get you a blanket...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Do you wanna sleep with me...?
Okay. Come here, boy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You're like a big, fluffy body pillow...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice that you two love each other so much, but you're going to catch a cold if you're not careful.
